title: Allows visitors to check multiple activities
goal: Use check boxes with the same name and different values ​​to represent a multi-selectable field.
summary: registration form allows simultaneous participation in the shared reading and repair workshops. The browser submits the value for each checked activity.
tasks: retains name="activity", and the values ​​of the two items remain reading and repair respectively, both of which are initially unselected.

example.code:
<label><input type="checkbox" name="skill" value="design"> design</label>
<label><input type="checkbox" name="skill" value="coding"> Programming</label>
example.note: Each selected checkbox will submit a set of key values with the same name, and the value is used to distinguish the options.

hint: checkbox can be checked independently. For radios with the same name, only one of them can be selected.
